STORY_IRR_PARAM.description: Story Irregularity Check Parameters (STORY_IRR_PARAM). Sets/gets the parameters used for the story irregularity check; the applicable seismic/design code (COUNTRY_CODE) drives which of the remaining fields are actually consumed.

Argument.description: Request body for setting the story irregularity check parameters.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: Country / design code used for the story irregularity check. Enum values are case-insensitive.

STORY_DRIFT_METHOD.description: Method used to evaluate story drift. Consumed only when COUNTRY_CODE is not IS1893(2016) and not IS16700(2023). Enum values are case-insensitive.
enum: Drift at the Center of Mass
Max. Drift of Outer Extreme Points
Max. Drift of All Vertical Elements

STORY_STIFFNESS_METHOD.description: Method used to evaluate story stiffness. Consumed only when COUNTRY_CODE is not IS1893(2016) and not IS16700(2023). Enum values are case-insensitive.

SEISMIC_BEHAVIOR_FACTOR.description: [COUNTRY_CODE=NTCS2020 or NTCS2023] Seismic behavior factor, Q. Consumed only when COUNTRY_CODE is NTCS2020 or NTCS2023. Enum values are case-insensitive.

Argument.STORY_DRIFT_METHOD: Drift at the Center of Mass
